production.note: US model years. Start: Honda's '2006 Honda Civic Coupe and Civic Si Specifications' (released August 29, 2005). End: Cars.com lists 2011 Civic Si trims ('2dr Man Si', '4dr Man Si') at 197 hp (cars-com-civic-si-2011); Honda's 2012 powertrains release: 'The Civic Si produces 201 horsepower, up 4 horsepower versus the 2.0-liter engine it replaces' (honda-civic-powertrains-2012), so the 197 hp 2.0 ended with 2011.

body.note: Cars.com 2011 lists '2dr Man Si' (coupe, FG2) and '4dr Man Si' (sedan, FA5). Honda's 2006 specifications cover the coupe; the standard car here is the coupe. The Si sedan was not offered at launch (Honda's 2006 specifications list only the coupe).

transmission.note: 'Close-Ratio 6-Speed Manual Transmission' marked for the Si; the automatic column is '--' (no automatic Si). Cars.com 2011 Si: '6-Speed M/T' (cars-com-civic-si-2011).

powerHp.note: Quote (Honda 2006 specifications, Si column): "Horsepower* @ rpm (SAE net) | 197 @ 7800", footnote "*Horsepower and torque calculations reflect new SAE J1349 procedures revised August, 2004." Cars.com 2011 '4dr Man Si': "197 @ 7800" (cars-com-civic-si-2011), so the rating held for the whole run.

weightLb.note: 2006 Civic Si coupe, 6-speed manual (the only transmission). Quote (Honda 2006 specifications, Si column): "Curb Weight (lbs., MT/AT) | 2877 / --". Cars.com gives the 2011 Si sedan at 2,954 lb (cars-com-civic-si-2011).
